blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — After last year’s brouhaha over a P500 budget for Noche Buena, the president of the League of Provinces of the Philippines, South Cotabato Gov. Reynaldo Tamayo Jr., now said that P1,000 is enough for that traditional midnight family feast on Christmas Eve. Tamayo, who also serves as president of the ruling Partido Federal ng Pilipinas, said the amount could already pay “for a simple Noche Buena celebration for a family of three to six members,” stressing Christmas Eve does not have to involve an elaborate feast.
